<noinclude><pagequality level="1" user="" /></noinclude><section begin=par127 />only a subsequent insertion; so also {{GHGheb|text=יִשְׂרָאֵל}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Jos|chapter=8|verse=33}}b (cf. LXX), {{GHGbible-ref|book=2 S|chapter=20|verse=23}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=2 K|chapter=7|verse=13}}, {{GHGheb|text=הַמֶּ֫לֶךְ}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=1 S|chapter=26|verse=22}} after {{GHGheb|text=הַחֲנִיה}} (simplified by the Masora to {{GHGheb|text=חֲנִית}} {{GHGterm|Q<sup>e</sup>rê}}); {{GHGheb|text=עֲלִיַּת אָחָז}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=2 K|chapter=23|verse=12}}, {{GHGheb|text=אַשּׁוּר}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Is|chapter=36|verse=8}} (cf. {{GHGbible-ref|book=2 K|chapter=18|verse=23}}), {{GHGheb|text=הַקֹּדֶשׁ}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ez|chapter=46|verse=19}} (unless the article with {{GHGheb|text=לשכות}} is to be omitted), also {{GHGheb|text=הַתָּמִיד}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Dn|chapter=8|verse=13}}, and {{GHGheb|text=עֹדֵד הַנָּבִיא}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=2 Ch|chapter=15|verse=8}}. In {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ex|chapter=9|verse=18}} read with the Samaritan {{GHGheb|text=לְמִיּוֹם}}; in {{GHGbible-ref|book=2 S|chapter=19|verse=25}} {{GHGheb|text=לֶ֫כֶת}} might possibly be taken in apposition to {{GHGheb|text=לְמִן הַיּוֹם}}; in {{GHGbible-ref|book=2 K|chapter=10|verse=1}} restore {{GHGheb|text=אֶת־בְּנֵי}}, with the LXX and Lucian, before {{GHGheb|text=אַחְאָב}}; in {{GHGbible-ref|book=2 K|chapter=25|verse=19}} omit the article, as in {{GHGbible-ref|book=Jer|chapter=52|verse=25}}, before {{GHGheb|text=סֹפֵר}}.

{{GHGmargin-letter|127|g}}
A similar ellipse must also be assumed in {{GHGbible-ref|book=2 K|chapter=23|verse=17}} ''the sepulchre is'' the sepulchre ''of the man of God'' (but most probably {{GHGheb|text=קֶבֶר}} has dropped out after {{GHGheb|text=הַקֶּבֶר}}) and {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ps|chapter=123|verse=4}} (cf., however, the LXX, and observe that in the parallel member the genitive is paraphrased by {{GHGheb|text=לְ}}).—In {{GHGbible-ref|book=Jos|chapter=3|verse=14}} {{GHGheb|text=הַבְּרִית}} (verse 17 {{GHGheb|text=בְּרִית יהוה}}) has been added to the original {{GHGheb|text=הָֽאָרוֹן}} by a redactor; cf. similar syntactically impossible additions in verse 11 (also in {{GHGbible-ref|book=1 S|chapter=4|verse=3}}, &c., where the LXX still had simply {{GHGheb|text=אֲרוֹן יהוה}}); in {{GHGheb|text=הַיְחַד}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ju|chapter=16|verse=14}} the Masora evidently combines two different readings {{GHGheb|text=הַיָּחֵד}} and {{GHGheb|text=יְתַד הָאֶרֶג}}; and similarly in {{GHGbible-ref|book=Jer|chapter=25|verse=26}} (where {{GHGheb|text=הָאָ֫רֶץ}} was only subsequently introduced into the text), the two readings {{GHGheb|text=הַמַּמְלָכוֹת}} and {{GHGheb|text=מַמְלְכוֹת הָא׳}} are combined.—In {{GHGbible-ref|book=Jos|chapter=8|verse=11}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=1 K|chapter=14|verse=24}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Jer|chapter=31|verse=40}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ez|chapter=45|verse=16}} the article, being usual after {{GHGheb|text=כָּל־}}, has been mechanically added, and so also in {{GHGbible-ref|book=2 Ch|chapter=8|verse=16}} after {{GHGheb|text=עַד־}}; in {{GHGbible-ref|book=2 K|chapter=9|verse=4}} the second {{GHGheb|text=הַנַּ֫עַד}} (instead of {{GHGheb|text=נַ֫עַר}}) is occasioned by the first; in {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ez|chapter=7|verse=7}} {{GHGheb|text=מְהוּמָה}} belongs as a nominative to what follows; in {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ez|chapter=8|verse=29}} the meaning perhaps is ''in the chambers, in the house of the Lord'', or the article is to be omitted; in {{GHGbible-ref|book=1 Ch|chapter=15|verse=27}} the text is manifestly corrupt.

{{GHGmargin-letter|127|h}}
Of another kind are the instances in which a determinate noun is followed by a definition of the material ''in apposition'' (hence, not in the genitive; cf. § 131), e.g. {{GHGbible-ref|book=Zc|chapter=4|verse=10}} {{GHGheb|text=הָאֶ֫בֶן הַבְּדִיל|translate=the weight, the lead}}, i.e. ''the leaden weight''; {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ex|chapter=39|verse=17}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=2 K|chapter=16|verse=14}} ({{GHGheb|text=הַנְּח֫שֶׁת}}, both here and in verse 17, is probably only a later addition, while {{GHGheb|text=המסגרות המכנות}} in verse 17 has arisen from a confusion of two readings, {{GHGheb|text=מסגרות המכנות}} and {{GHGheb|text=המסגרות מֵהמכנות}}). In {{GHGbible-ref|book=Jer|chapter=32|verse=12}} also {{GHGheb|text=הַמִּקְנָה}} (unless the article is simply to be omitted) is in apposition to {{GHGheb|text=הַסֵּפֶר}}.

{{GHGmargin-letter|127|i}}
(''b'') Before a noun with a suffix (which likewise represents a determinate genitive; see above, at the beginning of this section). This does not apply to cases in which a {{GHGterm|verbal}} (i.e. ''accusative'') suffix is affixed to a participle which has the article, e.g. {{GHGheb|text=הַמַּכֵּ֫הוּ}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Is|chapter=9|verse=12}}, ''the one smiting him''; in {{GHGbible-ref|book=Dt|chapter=8|verse=15}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Dt|chapter=13|verse=6|hidebook=1}} also {{GHGheb|text=ךָ}} is a verbal suffix, but hardly the {{GHGheb|text=וֹ}} in {{GHGheb|text=הָֽעֹשׂוֹ}} for {{GHGheb|text=הָֽעֹשֵׂ֫הוּ}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Job|chapter=40|verse=19}}, nor the {{GHGheb|text=־ָהּ}} in {{GHGheb|text=הַיֹּֽלְדָהּ}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Dn|chapter=11|verse=6}}; {{GHGpar|116|g}}. For {{GHGheb|text=הָֽעֶרְכְּךָ}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Lev|chapter=27|verse=23}}, read {{GHGheb|text=עֶרְכְּךָ}} as in verses 2, 3, 5, 7, 13, &c., twelve times (but cf. also the note on {{GHGpar|128|d}}).—Of the remaining examples {{GHGheb|text=כַּגְּבִרְתָּהּ}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Is|chapter=24|verse=2}} (probably an intentional alliteration with the eleven other words beginning with {{GHGheb|text=כַּ‍}}), {{GHGheb|text=לַמַּֽעֲנֵ֫הוּ}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Pr|chapter=16|verse=4}}, and {{GHGheb|text=בֶּֽעָרֵ֫ינוּ}} (so Baer, following the best authorities) {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ezr|chapter=10|verse=14}}, rest only on the authority of the Masoretes, not of the authors. So also in {{GHGheb|text=הָאָֽהֳלִי}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Jos|chapter=7|verse=21}}, {{GHGheb|text=הַֽחֶצְיוֹ}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Jos|chapter=8|verse=33}} (previously {{GHGheb|text=חֶצְיוֹ}}), {{GHGheb|text=הֶהָֽרוֹתֶ֫יהָ}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=2 K|chapter=15|verse=16}} (dittography of the {{GHGheb|text=ה}}), the article is simply to be omitted as syntactically impossible; the {{GHGheb|text=ו}} of {{GHGheb|text=הַדָּבְרוֹ}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Mi|chapter=2|verse=12}} is the copula belonging to the next word.<section end=par127 /><noinclude>
